# get { #crossrepo.get }

```python
crossrepo.get(
    repo,
    filename,
    version=None,
    *,
    owner=None,
    out=None,
    refresh=False,
    quiet=False,
    cfg=None,
)
```

Download one result file, addressed by repository and file name.

This is the form meant for a notebook. Passing `version` pins the result, and
the call is then silent and reproducible. Leaving it out takes the latest
version and prints the argument that pins it, ready to be pasted into the
call.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository name, optionally written ``owner/repo`` when the name alone is used by two organisations.

<code>[**filename**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   File name, or as much of the path as is needed to be unambiguous within the repository.

<code>[**version**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Hash of the commit holding the wanted version, a unique prefix of one, or a tag name. `None` takes the latest version and prints its hash.

<code>[**owner**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Repository owner, an alternative to writing ``owner/repo`` in `repo`.

<code>[**out**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Union](`typing.Union`)\[[str](`str`), [Path](`pathlib.Path`)\]\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Also write a copy here. A directory, or a path written with a trailing separator, keeps the original file name, and missing parent directories are created.

<code>[**refresh**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Rescan the repositories before resolving, instead of using the stored catalog.

<code>[**quiet**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Do not print the hash even when `version` was not given. The warning that a pinned version has been overtaken is still printed, on standard error: it says something happened rather than merely reporting.

<code>[**cfg**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Config](`crossrepo.config.Config`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Settings. Defaults to [](`crossrepo.config.active_config`): what [](`crossrepo.config.use_config`) registered, or the configuration file.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Path](`pathlib.Path`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Path of the file in the local cache, ready to hand to a reader.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[LookupError](`LookupError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If nothing matches, if several files match, or if there is no such version. The message lists the candidates as full specs.

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[FileNotFoundError](`FileNotFoundError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If the file is held in Git LFS and its content has not been fetched into the repository, or is published as a link and the link resolves to nothing on the machine holding the repository.

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ValueError](`ValueError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If the file is published as a link and the content it points at is not what its stamp records, which means it was regenerated without being stamped again.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

Read the latest version, and be told what pins it:

```python
import crossrepo
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv(crossrepo.get("x-gwas", "hits.csv"))
# Add version="4f2a9c1e8b7d6350a1c4e9f2b8d70a3c5e1f9b24" to pin this version.
```

Paste that argument in, so the notebook reads the same bytes next year:

```python
df = pd.read_csv(crossrepo.get(
    "x-gwas", "hits.csv", version="4f2a9c1e8b7d6350a1c4e9f2b8d70a3c5e1f9b24"
))
```
